pageProvenance: sourceContext.pageUrl: actual current document URL, validated against native event.pageUrl
sourceContext.requestedSource: the selected target, validated against current native job
pageMetadata.descriptionField: reference to the legacy flat description field, never a second large text copy
description: backward-compatible page-description alias, not inferred post caption
postEvidence: source/sourceUrl: exact observed first-party permalink, not publisher proof
text: observed node h1 or OG description only on validated same-post locator
timestamp: observed time[datetime], absent if missing
author.observedText: raw observed header text; no structured publisher or collaborator claim
media: observed descriptor with its existing page/element evidence
unresolvedFields: publisher_identity_unverified and collaboration_unverified remain explicit

compatibility: Keep schemaVersion1, source/id/type fields, author shape and legacy description alias; do not mutate old accepted artifacts.

Run large textFields/part transport tests to preserve record field roles and frame bounds, then release/runtime source hashes and all service smoke checks.
